uzo.purpose: Shows a command or a place in a file as code a person can read, select and copy: named by its caption, never cut off — a long line scrolls.

instead.kialo: A piece of code inside a sentence is a teksto with kind code, because it stands in the line of the text; a code block stands on its own.

boundary.kialo: A comparison of two versions line by line is no code block, because every line says what changed with a mark and a word; it stays with the application until a second one needs it.
Colours per kind of word are not supported, because a colour names no word (WCAG 1.4.1) and every language would need a grammar; the code stands in one colour.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A code block stands in a section of a page where the text that explains it stands, because the command belongs to its explanation.

containers.name: table
containers.kialo: A place in a file can head a row of a table, because the finding of the row is about it.

with.kialo: The text before a code block says what it does, because a command without its purpose is a risk.
